title: Quick Egg Tacos
subtitle: Fast egg tacos when the crew needs food in fifteen minutes.
description: Scrambled eggs, cheese, and salsa in warm tortillas — fifteen-minute breakfast when the tones drop and the crew still needs to eat.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.instruction: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in a 200°F oven so they stay pliable and don't crack when folded.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: Scramble eggs over medium-low heat until just set and still glossy. Fold in cheese off heat.

steps.title: Build tacos for the line
steps.instruction: Fill each tortilla with eggs, salsa, and optional avocado. Keep built tacos seam-side down on a warm tray.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Tacos don't hold well—serve in two waves if needed. Pass hot sauce and crema on the side.

stationWorkflow: Assign one cook to the hot surface and one to assembly. Keep the line moving; don’t crowd the griddle.
Set a warm holding zone (oven 200°F or covered hotel pan) so staggered eaters still get a hot plate.
Run a quick call-proof check: anything crispy stays uncovered; anything soft stays covered.
cleanupNotes: While plates are served, scrape the griddle/pan and wipe with a damp towel (use tongs + folded towel).
Soak the mixing bowl and sheet pan immediately—breakfast starch sets fast when it cools.
leftovers: Cool fast: spread on a sheet pan 10 minutes, then portion into containers so it doesn’t sweat.
Reheat rule: eggs reheat best covered at 50% power or low oven heat; don’t nuke on high.
